 Five more die of dengue, 1,898 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 376 this year 
 Published : 24 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 24 October 2026, 16:42
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least five dengue patients died and 1,898 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, two were reported in Chattogram division, while one each was reported in Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) and Khulna and Rajshahi divisions.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths and cases, the death toll this year has risen to 376, while the total number of cases has reached 121,699.
 Currently, 6,190 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
